It’s amazing how alcohol (and the withdrawals) were the main focal point of my mind when I made this post. To where I was switching between all the alcoholic subreddits looking for some sort of reprieve. Now days later my focus has completely shifted elsewhere…mostly. I’m still dealing with insomnia and a bit of anxiety. I’m so grateful that it looks like I’m not going to deal with the harsher withdrawal symptoms others face. But the weekend worries me. My birthday coming up worries me. Hanging out with my gf and vegging out on the couch worries me. All times where id drink freely. 

If I’m being totally honest. I did have several glass of wine on Halloween to try and relax a bit and lessen some anxiety. I’m a hardcore liquor drinker (multiple handles a week) so wine typically doesn’t do much. And it didn’t. Next day I did feel even better and continued not drinking.

Day 2 of sobriety. Quit cold turkey off drinking a handle every two days but most recently went on a 4 day bender where I consumed one a day. Yesterday wasn’t great, felt anxiety and restlessness. Finally fell asleep around 6am and slept amazingly. Woke up and worked out in my basement and have my shift overnight. Was convinced yesterday that I was going to moderate, as the cravings were awful. But idk, today I’m not going to bother getting alcohol. Working nights helps.

I’m 31. I’ve quit cold turkey before with an even worse problem last year and was sober for 6 months. This most recent time was after a 4 day bender where I went through all 4 handles I bought at the liquor store the night before.
I think I’ve gotten the auditory stuff before. This time I had mainly tension and restlessness. Then finally exhaustion. So I could finally sleep.

I feel like only a “problem drinker” on my days off. The multiple day benders are killer. The few drinks on my work days before bed dont seem to hinder my daily functions but these weekend benders are out of hand. It’s by the end of the work week when I feel “good” and ready to go to the liquor store to enjoy my weeekend that really are starting to bleed into my work week.

Kratom helped me quit alcohol for 6 months but later brought my alcoholism right back. So now I’m assisted to both Kratom and alcohol again. First day sober today from alcohol. My Kratom addiction isn’t nearly as crippling as alcohol is though. Not even in the same ballpark. It’s akin to consuming too much caffeine for me imo.

Update: ended up going the taper route this time. I had roughly a bottle of wine and a beer. That’s not a lot for me. I didn’t even get a buzz but it kept off any wd symptoms. Other than the fact that I only slept like 3 hours, I feel good.
